connectedAccounts.title: Connected Accounts
connectedAccounts.connectGoogleDescription: Connect Google to sign in to this same Project Recall account.
connectedAccounts.disconnectGoogleConfirmBody: You will no longer be able to sign in to this Project Recall account with %{email}. Your account data and other connected identities will remain available.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.summary: Permanently delete this Project Recall account and its private cloud and local data.
deleteAccount.warningBody: Projects, sessions, recordings, notes, bookmarks, timeline events, evidence files, connected identities, and account access will be permanently removed.
deleteAccount.offlineWarning: Keep this device online until deletion and local cleanup finish.
deleteAccount.finalBody: The account and all eligible Project Recall data will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.progressBody: Do not close Project Recall while the deletion request is being processed.
deleteAccount.cleanupBody: The cloud account is deleted. Project Recall is removing private data from this device.
deleteAccount.blockedBody: Shared workspace data must be resolved before this account can be deleted automatically.
deleteAccount.reauthBody: For security, sign out and sign in again before requesting account deletion.
deleteAccount.recordingActive: Stop or discard the current recording before continuing.
deleteAccount.unverifiedCleanupTitle: Removing private data from this device
deleteAccount.unverifiedCleanupBody: Project Recall could not verify whether cloud deletion finished. Private data on this device is being removed before you continue.
deleteAccount.unverifiedCompleteTitle: Private data removed from this device
deleteAccount.unverifiedCompleteBody: Project Recall could not verify whether the cloud account was deleted. You can continue safely, then try signing in again later to confirm the cloud account status.
